📐 Design Contract: Cell padding is 0px. Components touch the grid borders directly. ✓ Aligned with "Delivered" flush design

📐 1. "The Component IS the Cell" (Flush Zero-Gap Design)

In conventional component libraries, data cells render components as isolated child widgets wrapped inside nested <div> containers with internal padding, borders, and margins. This causes double borders, uneven vertical alignment, and massive layout thrashing during virtual scrolling.

❌ Legacy Nested Anti-Pattern

Cell has p-2, child component has internal margin, borders, and pill rounding. White gaps exist between grid lines and component.

✅ Hyperstack Flush Cell Architecture

Cell has p-0 m-0 h-10 w-full. The component's slots stretch directly to the grid borders with zero nested margins.

⚙️ 2. Declarative HTML & Component Registry

Declare your column archetypes with compid or coltyp. The grid looks up the adapter in HxGrid.CellRegistry, mounting DOM elements once and recycling them forever. 

<!-- 1. Include the Grid engine -->
<script src="/htmx-grid.js"></script>

<!-- 2. Declarative 1,000,000-row Grid bound to JSON API -->
<div hx-grid 
     hx-grid-src="/api/invoices.json" 
     hx-grid-row-height="40">
</div>

<!-- 3. Component Registry (Flyweight Pattern) & Server Directives -->
<script>
  const grid = new HxGrid.EnterpriseDataGrid(document.getElementById('my-grid'), {
    rowHeight: 40, // Exact 40px flush match: The Component IS the Cell
    columns: [
      { field: 'id', header: 'ID', compid: 'text', width: 90 },
      
      // Compound MetaText (2x2 + Hero, zero nested gap)
      { field: 'client', header: 'Client & Account', compid: 'metatext', width: 280 },
      
      // Chips with Server-Pushed Directives (Single vs Multi select)
      { 
        field: 'tags', 
        header: 'Acuity Tags', 
        compid: 'chipsui', 
        width: 180,
        directives: { mode: 'single', maxTags: 1 } // 0.0ms local radio enforcement!
      },
      
      // Flush Status Dropdown
      { field: 'status', header: 'Status', compid: 'dropdown', width: 140 },
      
      { field: 'date', header: 'Due Date', compid: 'date', width: 110 }
    ],
    data: myInvoiceData // Raw primitive arrays/tuples (Zero HTML overhead across 1M rows!)
  });

  // Hot-push server directives dynamically without page reload:
  grid.applyDirectives('tags', { mode: 'multi', maxTags: 5 });
</script>

🐹 3. 1:1 Go DSL Parity (go/components/components.go)

In accordance with repository directives, every HTML component has a matching pure Go DSL constructor with zero runtime allocations: 

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "hyperstack/components"
)

func Handler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    grid := components.HxGrid(components.HxGridProps{
        ID:        "logistics-grid",
        RowHeight: 40,
        Columns: []components.GridColumn{
            {Field: "id", Header: "ID", CompID: "text", Width: 80},
            {Field: "patient", Header: "Demographic", CompID: "metatext", Width: 280},
            {
                Field:  "tags", 
                Header: "Classification", 
                CompID: "chipsui", 
                Width:  160, 
                Directives: &components.CellDirectives{Mode: "single", MaxTags: 1},
            },
            {Field: "status", Header: "Live Status", CompID: "dropdown", Width: 140},
            {Field: "eta", Header: "ETA Date", CompID: "date", Width: 100},
        },
        DataURL: "/api/patients/stream",
    })

    fmt.Fprint(w, grid.Render())
}

How 1,000,000-Row Zero-Lag Virtualization Works

  • The Component IS the Cell: Zero cell padding or margin (p-0 m-0 h-10). The element touches the gridlines flush.
  • Flyweight DOM Recycling: The grid creates a fixed pool of only ~30 visible row elements. Scrolling at 120fps triggers zero DOM node allocations.
  • Server-Pushed Directives: The server pushes behavioral constraints (mode: "single") down via the schema. The client executes them in 0.0ms with zero HTTP round-trips.
  • Zero-Markup Wire Payload: The server sends raw primitive tuples instead of 500MB of repetitive HTML tags.
  • Multi-Tab & Multi-Grid Scoping: Independent grid ID namespaces prevent key collisions; global updates broadcast over the shared signal bus without forcing non-visible tabs to re-render.

  <!-- Interactive Script for Live Preview -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      let isSingle = true;
      const roleBtn = document.getElementById('demo-role-btn');
      const roleLabel = document.getElementById('demo-role-label');
      const roleIcon = document.getElementById('demo-role-icon');
      const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.demo-chip');
      const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.grid-status-dropdown');

      function updateKPIs() {
        let deliv = 0, pend = 0;
        dropdowns.forEach(dd => {
          if (dd.value === 'delivered') deliv++;
          else if (dd.value === 'pending') pend++;
        });
        const dEl = document.getElementById('kpi-delivered');
        const pEl = document.getElementById('kpi-pending');
        if (dEl) dEl.textContent = deliv;
        if (pEl) pEl.textContent = pend;
      }

      dropdowns.forEach(dd => {
        dd.addEventListener('change', () => {
          dd.className = 'grid-status-dropdown h-full w-full text-xs font-bold bg-transparent border-0 rounded-none px-2.5 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer';
          if (dd.value === 'delivered') dd.classList.add('text-emerald-600');
          else if (dd.value === 'pending') dd.classList.add('text-amber-600');
          else dd.classList.add('text-indigo-600');
          updateKPIs();
        });
      });

      chips.forEach(chip => {
        chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (isSingle) {
            const cell = chip.closest('.chips-cell');
            if (cell) cell.querySelectorAll('.demo-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-indigo-600', 'bg-indigo-600', 'text-white'));
            chip.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-indigo-600', 'bg-indigo-600', 'text-white');
          } else {
            chip.classList.toggle('ring-2');
            chip.classList.toggle('ring-indigo-600');
            chip.classList.toggle('bg-indigo-600');
            chip.classList.toggle('text-white');
          }
        });
      });

      if (roleBtn) {
        roleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          isSingle = !isSingle;
          if (isSingle) {
            roleLabel.textContent = 'Nurse (mode: "single")';
            roleIcon.textContent = '👩‍⚕️';
            roleBtn.className = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer';
          } else {
            roleLabel.textContent = 'Physician (mode: "multi")';
            roleIcon.textContent = '👨‍⚕️';
            roleBtn.className = 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-purple-600 text-white hover:bg-purple-700 transition shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer';
          }
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>

        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50/50 border border-emerald-200 space-y-2">
        <div class="font-bold text-emerald-700 uppercase">✅ Hyperstack Flush Cell Architecture</div>
        <p class="text-slate-600 font-sans text-xs">
          Cell has <code class="bg-white px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700">p-0 m-0 h-10 w-full</code>. The component's slots stretch directly to the grid borders with zero nested margins.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Section 2: Declarative HTML Usage & Component Registry -->
  <div class="space-y-4 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200">
    <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
      <span>⚙️</span> 2. Declarative HTML & Component Registry
    </h2>
    <p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
      Declare your column archetypes with <code class="font-mono text-indigo-600 font-semibold">compid</code> or <code class="font-mono text-indigo-600 font-semibold">coltyp</code>. The grid looks up the adapter in <code class="font-mono text-indigo-600 font-semibold">HxGrid.CellRegistry</code>, mounting DOM elements once and recycling them forever.
    </p>

    <div class="bg-[#1e293b] text-[#e2e8f0] rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed shadow-sm">
      <pre>&lt;!-- 1. Include the Grid engine --&gt;
&lt;script src="/htmx-grid.js"&gt;&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;!-- 2. Declarative 1,000,000-row Grid bound to JSON API --&gt;
&lt;div hx-grid 
     hx-grid-src="/api/invoices.json" 
     hx-grid-row-height="40"&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;

&lt;!-- 3. Component Registry (Flyweight Pattern) & Server Directives --&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
  const grid = new HxGrid.EnterpriseDataGrid(document.getElementById('my-grid'), {
    rowHeight: 40, // Exact 40px flush match: The Component IS the Cell
    columns: [
      { field: 'id', header: 'ID', compid: 'text', width: 90 },
      
      // Compound MetaText (2x2 + Hero, zero nested gap)
      { field: 'client', header: 'Client & Account', compid: 'metatext', width: 280 },
      
      // Chips with Server-Pushed Directives (Single vs Multi select)
      { 
        field: 'tags', 
        header: 'Acuity Tags', 
        compid: 'chipsui', 
        width: 180,
        directives: { mode: 'single', maxTags: 1 } // 0.0ms local radio enforcement!
      },
      
      // Flush Status Dropdown
      { field: 'status', header: 'Status', compid: 'dropdown', width: 140 },
      
      { field: 'date', header: 'Due Date', compid: 'date', width: 110 }
    ],
    data: myInvoiceData // Raw primitive arrays/tuples (Zero HTML overhead across 1M rows!)
  });

  // Hot-push server directives dynamically without page reload:
  grid.applyDirectives('tags', { mode: 'multi', maxTags: 5 });
&lt;/script&gt;</pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Section 3: 1:1 Go DSL Parity -->
  <div class="space-y-4 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200">
    <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
      <span>🐹</span> 3. 1:1 Go DSL Parity (<code class="text-indigo-600 font-mono">go/components/components.go</code>)
    </h2>
    <p class="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
      In accordance with repository directives, every HTML component has a matching pure Go DSL constructor with zero runtime allocations:
    </p>

    <div class="bg-[#1e293b] text-[#e2e8f0] rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed shadow-sm">
      <pre>package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "hyperstack/components"
)

func Handler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    grid := components.HxGrid(components.HxGridProps{
        ID:        "logistics-grid",
        RowHeight: 40,
        Columns: []components.GridColumn{
            {Field: "id", Header: "ID", CompID: "text", Width: 80},
            {Field: "patient", Header: "Demographic", CompID: "metatext", Width: 280},
            {
                Field:  "tags", 
                Header: "Classification", 
                CompID: "chipsui", 
                Width:  160, 
                Directives: &components.CellDirectives{Mode: "single", MaxTags: 1},
            },
            {Field: "status", Header: "Live Status", CompID: "dropdown", Width: 140},
            {Field: "eta", Header: "ETA Date", CompID: "date", Width: 100},
        },
        DataURL: "/api/patients/stream",
    })

    fmt.Fprint(w, grid.Render())
}</pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Section 4: Million Record Architecture Guide -->
  <div class="space-y-4 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200">
    <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">How 1,000,000-Row Zero-Lag Virtualization Works</h3>
    <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-2 leading-relaxed">
      <li><strong class="text-slate-900">The Component IS the Cell:</strong> Zero cell padding or margin (<code class="bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">p-0 m-0 h-10</code>). The element touches the gridlines flush.</li>
      <li><strong class="text-slate-900">Flyweight DOM Recycling:</strong> The grid creates a fixed pool of only ~30 visible row elements. Scrolling at 120fps triggers zero DOM node allocations.</li>
      <li><strong class="text-slate-900">Server-Pushed Directives:</strong> The server pushes behavioral constraints (<code class="bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono">mode: "single"</code>) down via the schema. The client executes them in 0.0ms with zero HTTP round-trips.</li>
      <li><strong class="text-slate-900">Zero-Markup Wire Payload:</strong> The server sends raw primitive tuples instead of 500MB of repetitive HTML tags.</li>
      <li><strong class="text-slate-900">Multi-Tab & Multi-Grid Scoping:</strong> Independent grid ID namespaces prevent key collisions; global updates broadcast over the shared signal bus without forcing non-visible tabs to re-render.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

</div>
